low.label: Low
low.hint: Quick — fine for small, clear changes.

high.label: High
high.hint: Thinks longer — good for tricky changes.

xhigh.label: Extra high
xhigh.hint: Thinks much longer on hard problems.

max.label: Max
max.hint: The most thinking — slowest, for the hardest work.

picker.autoHint: Copilot picks the model for each request.
picker.autoHintFusion: Copilot picks the models for each request.
picker.missing: Not available anymore. Choose another model.
picker.addKeyModels: Add models with your API keys…
picker.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the models. Close this and open it again to retry.
picker.longWindow: A long window keeps more of your app and the conversation in view.
picker.fusionNote: High and Max can use more than one model, such as one to review another’s work, so a request can take longer and cost more.
picker.busy: The model can’t be changed while the assistant is working

errors.generic: That didn’t work. Please try again.
errors.saveModels: Couldn’t save your choice of models.

providers.title: Model providers
providers.sub: Use models from these providers with your own API keys in Build chat, the Advisor and Design. The provider bills you for them. Copilot still runs the conversation, so stay signed in to GitHub Copilot.
providers.unsupported: Fabricator can’t keep API keys safely on this operating system yet.
providers.checkTitle: Check the key with {{name}} again and update its models
providers.keyHint: Fabricator checks it with {{name}}, then keeps it in {{store}} on this computer.

chatDefaults.title: Chat defaults
chatDefaults.sub: A new project’s chat starts with these. After that, each project’s chat keeps its own, which you change in the chat.
chatDefaults.modelHint: With Auto, Copilot chooses a model for each request.
chatDefaults.noServersHint: Add the MCP servers chat can use, then choose the ones new chats start with.

instructions.title: Custom instructions
instructions.sub: Tell Copilot what you want in every app you build, such as a theme, wording or layout. Each app’s chat follows these from its next message, and what you ask in the chat comes first. They stay in Fabricator: they aren’t saved in your apps.
instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.hint: Keep them short: Copilot reads them with every message.

examples.theme: Use the system’s light or dark theme by default.
examples.case: Use sentence case for headings, labels and buttons.
